author: JerryRigEverything
description:
The new Framework 16 is a beast of a laptop - Mostly because it is taking on the world all by itself. Framework makes laptops that are modular, repairable, and Upgradable.  Want more RAM? Easy. Need a new Graphics card? Go for it. I'm a huge fan of what Framework is doing. Framework does provide a single screwdriver in its DIY Kit - but if you want to up your game - grab one of my professional tool kits here: https://www.ifixit.com/JerryRig

Get my Teardown Skin for your computer or phone HERE: https://www.dbrand.com/Teardown

The Framework 16 is basically a modular computer inside a laptop formfactor. And I'm all for it. This laptop was provided by Framework for review.
title: FINE - ILL DO IT MYSELF
